basic_profile.bio: A curious and tech-savvy individual from Portland, Oregon. With a background in mechanical engineering, I have a keen interest in urban design and sustainable technology. I work as a product designer for a startup focusing on innovative urban transportation solutions. My hobbies include playing narrative-driven video games and photography, especially using gear from Peak Design. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, Pacific Time, after work and during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and have worked on various projects related to urban mobility and green technology. My passion for video games and tech gadgets keeps me updated on the latest trends, and I often share insights and reviews based on my experiences.
